pages.title: One of the Cold Pack
pages.text: Suitable equipment helps you care for the icy pack more safely.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Obtain a dropped horn and make the disguise helmet. It permits approach until provoked; warmth weakens the creatures. This is camouflage, not universal taming.
